resources.string: Clear imported transactions appear after you confirm your accounts and cards. Continue setup to import messages or confirm ownership. If you already have transactions, check the selected month.
Add an account or card manually
Messages are saved. Continue to confirm which accounts and cards belong to you.
%1$d financial items saved. Clear transactions are processed automatically; review only the remaining unclear messages.
Clear transactions are added automatically for confirmed accounts and cards. Only messages with missing or conflicting information need review. You can return through Settings → Continue setup.

This permanently deletes imported messages, accounts, cards, loans, transactions, corrections, settings and local backups stored in the lab. Setup will start again. The main Masroof app, SMS on your phone and archives exported to other locations are unchanged.
No messages need review. Clear transactions for confirmed accounts and cards are added automatically.
%1$d messages are waiting for account or card confirmation. Confirm ownership once to process their clear transactions.
No messages need review. You can open Home.
%1$d messages need your decision. You can review them now or later.
